Continuous_Tread_Locomotion.description: Heavy, spiked iron caterpillar tracks driven by enormous toothed cogs. They reduce traversal speed to a loud, grinding crawl but provide absolute infallibility against being knocked prone or pushed back.

Pillar_Strut_Legs.description: Colossal columns of solid, unjointed granite that serve as the entity's legs. Moving requires dragging and lifting these massively heavy pillars with raw arcane force, heavily impeding agility.
